text:
ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of flatbread-style crust, golden-tan with browned edges and pale cream interior, topped with melted pale-yellow cheese with light browning spots and a thin orange-red sauce layer; footprint roughly 40% of plate width, about 12 cm long by 6 cm wide, about 1.5 cm thick at the crust | 110
ITEM 2 | Second wedge of similar crust with a reddish-brown granular meat-like topping, a thick slice of red tomato with glossy red skin and pale seeded flesh on top, edges browned and slightly charred; roughly 11 cm long by 6 cm wide, about 1.5 cm thick | 95
ITEM 3 | Pile of fresh dark-green spinach leaves, flat and glossy with slight moisture, some leaves whole and some folded, with thin white stems; covers about 35% of the plate on the right side, leaves about 1 to 2 mm thick, mound about 3 cm high | 60
ITEM 4 | Thin pale-pink onion rings, translucent edges with slightly wilted, soft texture, scattered among the greens near the top; about 4 cm total visible length | 5
ITEM 5 | Small pale-green celery or stalk pieces with fibrous texture, a single short piece sitting at the left edge beside the pizza wedge; about 3 cm long, 1 cm wide | 4
ITEM 6 | Small browned round pieces, possibly mushroom-like, with matte tan-brown surfaces and slightly glossy patches, clustered in a group of three near the bottom edge of the pizza; each about 2 cm across | 18
ITEM 7 | Dark reddish-brown wilted pieces, small and soft with a shriveled, slightly glossy surface, scattered among the spinach at the lower right; each about 1 cm | 4
